selections.claim: DBI202 có SQL queries trên Microsoft SQL Server

source_matches.source_excerpt: Be proficient in SQL, including Data Definition Language (DDL) for defining database structures and implementing constraints such as primary and foreign keys, UNIQUE, and CHECK constraints using Microsoft SQL Server. Use Data Manipulation Language (DML) to perform basic queries, multi-relation queries, nested queries, aggregation queries, and database modifications using INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE statements.

Understand T-SQL database programming concepts in Microsoft SQL Server and work with database views, cursors, stored procedures, functions, and triggers, including the use of triggers to enforce database constraints. Understand transaction concepts in database applications.
